_readme: Hand-edited intro text for every section of the site. Pages render these
strings verbatim, so plain markdown links work: [label](https://example.com).
Keep each value on a single line (one paragraph). Placeholders substituted
{pi}  the PI's English name     {pi_zh}     the PI's Chinese name
{email}  lab contact address    {scholar}   the PI's Google Scholar URL
{published} / {accepted}  publication counts on the publications page.
Set a value to "" to hide that intro.

home.hero: LabX is a research group in the School of Mathematics at South China University of Technology. We study AI theory and develop AI methods for biomedical sciences, materials science, and other emerging fields.
home.tools: We build software to make our methods and research workflows reusable.

about.intro: We develop AI methods and apply them to biomedical sciences and emerging scientific fields.

team.intro: LabX is led by Dr. {pi} ({pi_zh}) at the Department of Statistics and Financial Mathematics, {unit}, {university}. Personal pages link from members' names; email and academic profile links appear only where members have provided them.

publications.intro: See [{pi}'s Google Scholar profile]({scholar}) or other authors' Google Scholar profiles for their most recent publications.
publications.lead: Papers where {pi} is a (co-)first or (co-)corresponding author, newest first.
publications.collaborative: Papers where {pi} is a co-author or consortium member, newest first.
publications.book_chapters: Chapters, encyclopaedia entries and other book contributions.

tools.intro: Software tools by the team for the community. Documentation remains in each project's own site and is updated in place.

engage.themes: We welcome conversations with agencies and organizations interested in supporting collaborative research in:
engage.students: We welcome inquiries from prospective postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and master's students interested in our research. Availability depends on current projects, supervision capacity, and funding; this page does not imply that a funded position is open. Please email a brief introduction, CV, and research interests to [{email}](mailto:{email}).
engage.partnerships: We welcome conversations with agencies and organizations interested in supporting collaborative research in the themes listed above. Potential partners can contact us at [{email}](mailto:{email}) to discuss a research question, possible collaboration, and support needs.
engage.funding: The group's published work has been supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China, the U.S. National Institutes of Health, the U.S. National Science Foundation, and the Guangdong Basic and Applied Basic Research Foundation. We gratefully acknowledge these and all other agencies that have supported our research.
engage.contact: For all inquiries — prospective students, collaborations, and funding discussions — please reach us here.
